coinpaprika.jurisdiction_status: No explicit country exclusion was found in the API documentation reviewed; personal-use restriction applies and applicable-law compliance remains required.

coinranking.jurisdiction_status: No explicit country exclusion was found in the published API terms reviewed; account eligibility remains unverified until provider registration is accepted and an API key is issued. Applicable-law compliance remains the account holder's responsibility.
coinranking.free_plan_positioning: Official Free plan: 5,000 calls/month, 5 requests/second, one API key, up to 100 results/request, one year of price history, no credit card. Free key is required for reliable use; account eligibility remains unverified until key issuance.

coinmarketcap.jurisdiction_status: API personal terms require compliance with applicable law including OFAC; no account/key is configured and account eligibility is not verified. Keep excluded from production until an authenticated free key and eligibility are confirmed.

coingecko.reason: Provider's published terms exclude transactions with entities domiciled or residing in its listed excluded countries. The adapter is hard-disabled and must not issue requests; runtime reachability cannot override provider terms.

coincap.reason: CoinCap terms prohibit use by persons residing or present in jurisdictions sanctioned by OFAC. Do not use where this restriction applies; HTTP reachability is not eligibility.

coinlore.reason: Current terms prohibit automated bots, data mining and scraping; the public API documentation does not establish a clear exception for scheduled automated use. Do not use without written permission.

operational_rule: Production acceptance requires at least two independent, fresh, license-eligible providers with exact identity matches for all nine candidate assets. Any pair among CoinMarketCap Free Basic, Coinranking Free, and CoinPaprika Personal may qualify. Keyless CMC and CoinGecko do not count.
jurisdiction_handling: Do not store the owner's residence in public repository configuration. Evaluate provider-published eligibility and applicable-law restrictions separately from backend network reachability; an HTTP 200 is not contractual authorization.
